fact: On 22 January 2026 the DGE and ONECI signed a convention under which the national register of persons (RNPP) is to be the sole official source of voter identification data for the biometric electoral file.

Guineenews reports that ANDE is developing a public key infrastructure (PKI) to secure electronic signatures, and that nine draft texts on the state's electronic signature were under review on 21 October 2026.
